build_speech_lm: build a speech language model from a pretrained checkpoint by name using AutoModelForCausalLM
download_speech_lm: download and extract a speech language model checkpoint from the FBAI public files server
generate_with_offset: generate token sequences from a speech LM using input IDs and a configurable offset value
unzip_file: extract a zip file to a specified directory path using Python zipfile
summarize_speech_lm: summarize the speech language model module that downloads, builds, and generates with offset support
